news.title: Shippers' backup plan is getting more expensive
news.summary: When primary truckload carriers turn down freight, the backup carriers that step in are now charging noticeably more, and that gap is widening into Thanksgiving week.
news.why: Shippers should price tender-rejection risk into routing guides and contract talks rather than treating backup capacity as a free safety net.

news.title: DHL Express makes customs clearance easier for small cross-border shippers
news.summary: DHL Express has rolled out an AI tool across the U.S. and several other Americas markets that helps shippers identify goods and fill in tariff classifications on customs paperwork.
news.why: Small importers and exporters can cut classification errors and border holds, but they still own the accuracy of the HS codes they declare.

news.title: Two Tanker Incidents Reported Near Oman; Vessel Hit Mine East Of Hormuz
news.summary: Two more tankers ran into trouble around the Strait of Hormuz, one struck by an unidentified projectile off Oman and another reportedly damaged by a mine east of the strait.
news.why: Repeated strikes keep war-risk insurance and Gulf tanker rates elevated, which feeds through to fuel, resin and chemical input costs.

news.title: Russian Military-Linked Cargo Ship Burns After Suspected Drone Strike in Gulf of Finland
news.summary: A Russian freighter tied to military logistics caught fire after a suspected drone hit in the Gulf of Finland and drifted into Finnish waters.
news.why: Baltic shipping now carries added security and insurance risk, so importers routing through Northern European feeder ports should watch for delays and surcharges.

news.title: EU's Hansen Says U.S. Trade Uncertainty Is Drawing Mexico, Europe Closer
news.summary: The EU's agriculture chief argues that unpredictable U.S. tariff policy is pushing Mexico and Europe into a closer trade relationship, and he expects Mexico to ratify their interim deal soon, though Mexico has not set a date.
news.why: Companies sourcing through Mexico could gain lower-duty access to EU inputs and markets, which may reshape nearshoring cost comparisons.

news.title: Global Unions Target Amazon's Poor Labor History
news.summary: Union leaders from 19 countries signed an open letter asking governments to stop giving public contracts to Amazon and AWS and to review the ones already in place, citing its labor record.
news.why: Sellers and public-sector buyers that rely on Amazon logistics or cloud services should track whether procurement rules start to factor in labor practices.

news.title: FAA Ground Stop Proves Near Miss for Thanksgiving Food, Black Friday Retail
news.summary: Inbound Logistics looks at how a recent FAA ground stop came close to disrupting air shipments of Thanksgiving food and Black Friday merchandise.
news.why: Retailers leaning on air freight for last-minute holiday stock should keep a ground or expedited-truck fallback ready for short-notice airspace disruptions.

news.title: South Korean Shipbuilder Advances Plans for Nuclear-Powered LNG Carrier
news.summary: Samsung Heavy Industries signed an exclusive pact with a U.S. nuclear startup to design an LNG carrier powered by a nuclear reactor for commercial service.
news.why: It is a long-horizon bet, but nuclear propulsion could eventually cut fuel cost swings and emissions charges baked into ocean freight rates.

news.title: IMO Finds Just $10.5 Billion in Maritime Climate Finance
news.summary: An IMO review counted only about $10.5 billion in direct climate funding for shipping over six years, a tiny slice of global climate finance.
news.why: Thin funding for cleaner ships means decarbonization costs are more likely to reach shippers through green surcharges and fuel levies.

news.title: The Sale Was Made. Then the Margin Disappeared
news.summary: A contributed column argues that retailer deductions for shortages, late deliveries and compliance misses are an operations problem that starts at order, transport and billing handoffs, not just a finance issue.
news.why: Suppliers to big retailers can recover margin by tracing chargebacks back to specific shipping and labeling failures and fixing them at the source.
